output.one_liner: Agentic B2B support platform that tracks customer issues across channels and orchestrates AI agents and automation to investigate and resolve them.

auth.notes: REST API uses Bearer token authentication; MCP supports OAuth 2.0 or API token. Only Admins can create and manage API tokens.

evidence.snippet: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication. This means you'll need to pass your API token in the header of your request
Auth: OAuth 2.0 or an API token. Actions are performed as the signed-in user or the token's identity

access.notes: REST API and webhooks available on paid plan tiers shown in pricing table. Free trial available but requires sales contact. Sandbox environment listed as plan feature.

evidence.snippet: For Enterprise customers, our sales team will work with you on a custom quote.
Pylon offers free trials for prospects. Your sales representative will work with you on setting up the demo organization.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 300 requests per minute for most REST operations; rate limits apply per MCP tool

evidence.snippet: Webhooks are user-defined HTTP callbacks that are triggered by specific events within Pylon.
Server URL (US): https://mcp.usepylon.com | Server URL (EU): https://mcp.eu.usepylon.com
Pylon MCP server: connect ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor. Work issues, accounts, contacts, and your knowledge base

buildability.rationale: REST API and MCP are documented with Bearer/OAuth authentication; a toolkit could be built today, but requires paid plan via sales contact; PYLON_MCP toolkit demonstrates this is achievable.

overview_evidence.snippet: Pylon is the first agentic support platform built for B2B.
